text: zIndex is fully official and missing from all 4 reference docs. The Advanced JSON Canvas spec defines zIndex as an optional integer on the generic node. Both the spec and TypeScript typings confirm it. Reference docs have zero mentions.

interdimensionalEdges array is the official cross-portal edge serialization. Defined on CanvasFileNodeData (portal file node). Cross-portal edges are NOT in top-level edges[] — embedded on the portal node. VERIFY flag resolved.
Composite portal ID pattern confirmed at spec level: 'Refrain from using - in the ID, as it is used to identify and manage nodes that are from portals.' Hard constraint for AI-authored node IDs.

collapsedData is a runtime-only payload NOT in the spec. Only collapsed?: boolean is documented. collapsedData nests child nodes/edges with offset coordinates on the group node. Members removed from top-level nodes[] when collapsed.
ratio has a string sentinel 'No ratio enforcement' not reflected in spec type (ratio?: number). AI readers must tolerate the string; AI writers should prefer numeric or omit.
styleAttributes type includes null as valid value { [key: string]: string | null }. Templates carry styleAttributes; null is used for default/unset styling. Missing from reference docs.
Z-order vs array-order duality: spec says nodes in array are ascending by z-index, but zIndex is also a per-node field. AI must not assume array position = visual z-order.
fromEnd defaults to 'none', toEnd defaults to 'arrow' — documented in spec but not in reference docs. AI authoring must account for these defaults.
